question: Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose International Airport is situated in:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kolkata.**__

__
 
• Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose International Airport is located in **Kolkata.**__
 
• **Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose airport **is one of the** oldest airports** in India.
 
• **Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose International Airport **which was earlier known as** "Dum Dum Airport"** is situated i**n Kolkata.**
 
• It was **opened in 1924 AD** and it is the** fifth-busiest airport in India.​**
